title: VaultReadState
description: What the researcher has read in a project's vault (ADR 0049). Reading marks itself in the web UI; a mark records reading, approves nothing and no gate reads it.

project_id.title: ProjectId
project_id.description: Stable project identifier (lowercase slug). Never a path; paths live in the local registry.

digest.description: Hash of what the researcher read (title, gist, summary, full text, standing, key, support, evidence). A different hash later shows the note as revised.

read_at.title: Timestamp
read_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.
